# Gauge Pro Phase 0 — EdgeTX zone atlas

> **Histórico:** atlas del baseline monolítico; sus zonas siguen siendo evidencia visual, pero no
> describen el empaquetado actual. Consulte [`DOCUMENTATION.md`](DOCUMENTATION.md).

> Generated by `dev/zone_atlas.lua` from the checked-out EdgeTX layout maps and decoration formula. Do not hand-edit.

## Contract

- 16 standard layouts plus the separate app-mode layout are parsed from `radio/src/gui/colorlcd/layouts`.
- The 320×240, 480×272, and 800×480 shipped LCD scales use the firmware's integer scaling rules.
- Top bar, flight mode, sliders, trims, vertical hardware, and six-position-switch branches are enumerated and deduplicated.
- Responsive families retain the existing 64/105/180 logical-pixel thresholds, with `short-strip`, `tall`, and `topbar-micro` subprofiles.

## Atlas gate

The generator parsed **17 layouts**, produced **180 unique decoration roots** across targets, and classified **6570 exact zone rectangles**. Every rectangle has a size family and an orientation subprofile; Phase 1/2 tests can consume the same generator rather than maintain a second handwritten matrix.

The atlas deliberately preserves current dial breakpoints. It does not authorize changing Auto from dial to bar; it only adds `topbar-micro`, `short-strip`, and `tall` bar subprofiles within an already selected Bar style.
